text_block_list.text:
I brought Lucky Lilac to the infirmary 
after she was injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're makin' too big a deal out of 
a little scratch like this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
See, it wasn't really that bad of an 
injury, was it?
choice_data_list: Because you never know what might happen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's true. But thanks to dealing 
with it right away, the pain has subsided 
quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start heading back. We 
don't have all the time in the world to 
take it easy.
choice_data_list: No, let's just rest for today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Come now... For an Umamusume at Tracen 
Academy, an injury of this level is simply 
unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you know how patient and tough I 
can be, don't ya, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you that something of this 
level is nothing to me.
choice_data_list: That's exactly why I'm stopping you.
...Just make sure not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list:
Because I know you'll just keep enduring 
it all on your own

Because I know you'll just keep enduring 
it all on your own.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: It's not really like that for me...――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to say “I'm not stupid”-- but I 
really can't deny it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"You'll probably just bottle it up, endure 
it, and hide it away. Even though you know 
you shouldn't."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I won't be stubborn, and 
I'll make sure to get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In return, once I'm fully healed, I'd like 
a pretty tough menu, please.

Lucky Lilac had to devote herself entirely 
to treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Well then, shall we get back to 
training?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Nope, not at all. I'm totally, 
completely in top shape, yep!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for sayin' I could do it. If I 
push myself to move, the pain feels like 
it'll flare right back up.

I hurriedly cut the training short. She 
ended up having to take some time off to 
rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu, as expected of you, Trainer. You 
really understand me well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hah, whew... Yeah, no pain at all, feeling 
great.
choice_data_list:
Holding it all in is strictly forbidden, 
got it?

Holding it all in is strictly forbidden, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I promise to report if it 
starts hurting.

Having continued her training with 
caution, Lucky Lilac overcame her injury 
and made a smooth, successful comeback.
